operator_audit/report.json.interpretation: Approximation errors, not exact-operator equality. Smooth and mixed independent implementation objects; no tuning to pilot truth. Geometric correctness is verified separately.

precision_amendment.json.kind: one numerical precision repair before worm outcome evaluation
precision_amendment.json.selection: same fixed final update; no withheld or voxel truth used
precision_amendment.json.time_caps: unchanged 900s training and 300s inference; prior failed/smoke time charged to total
precision_amendment.json.reruns: one fresh FP32 attempt per planned worm acquisition; no automatic extension or further retries
precision_amendment.json.reason: AMP gradients nonfinite after 6 accepted updates with GradScaler; unscaled AMP and FP32 finite at preserved-state diagnostic; fresh FP32 16-step smoke passed
precision_amendment.json.normalization: unchanged fixed projection scale and gain

profile/report.json.selection: training-only throughput/precision; no clean or withheld evaluation loaded

protocol.json.question: Does per-acquisition self-supervised ICECREAM improve finite-angle reconstruction against matched FBP/SART?
protocol.json.regime: Per-acquisition self-supervised reconstruction; new random model for every acquisition
protocol.json.case_selection: First three train-role files in existing manifest order; prior intake and supervised training exposure; not pristine tests
protocol.json.reserved: All 24 reserved files forbidden before IO

geometry.axes: z,y,x volume; z,angle,detector TIFF; upstream computational x,y,z
geometry.sampling: all original angle/detector point samples, no averaging/resampling
geometry.support: 310x310 circular x-y support, 64 contiguous z; unknown simulator scaling

normalization.provenance: original worm004 development scale; no new clean-data normalization

noise.construction: two independent Gaussian full-grid draws from clean acquired signal, mask afterward; independent full fields never observed outside acquired mask

baselines.fbp: ramp; original 1.8deg quadrature, no pi/span renormalization; same pair average
baselines.tv: omitted: no verified matching regularized voxel baseline available
baselines.historical_cnn: omitted: 25x62 input and spaced slices do not match this new dense acquisition

training.architecture: official default unet3d_bf, 4 levels, f_maps64, bias-free cr, no dropout layer unless included by cr
training.full_angle_control: same network N2N with eq_weight=0; no wedge-changing symmetries
training.checkpoint: fixed final update from training-only profile; no withheld or truth selection
training.pair_normalization: fixed gain only, no per-observation random affine standardization
training.precision: AMP only if loss relative difference<=0.02 and full gradient relative difference<=0.05, all finite; otherwise FP32
training.budget_freeze: largest passing patch with >=3GiB free headroom; phantom min(2000,floor(240/step_seconds/25)*25), worm min(4000,floor(600/step_seconds/25)*25); at least100 else technical stop
training.inference: original two-pass expression and central-half overlap; streaming FP32 accumulation

progression.geometry: adjoint relative error<1e-11, 180deg reversal<1e-11, smooth analytic projection<0.06, full-angle scale error<0.06, shift error<0.5px; finite loss and nonzero finite gradients
progression.phantoms: run first three acquisitions before independent objects; settings already frozen, no tuning on truth
progression.worm: proceed after geometry and loss pass; absence of benefit is reportable, not grounds to tune
progression.extra_cases: up to two, same settings, only after initial worm finite completed training/inference
progression.stop: operator convention/scale failure or nonfinite training blocks dependent stages; preserve failure
progression.unrolled: secondary, skip for unresolved operator/model mismatch or primary budget; do not copy unlicensed official code
progression.reliability_seeds: optional, no automatic extension; otherwise noise/seed sensitivity untested

evaluation.unit: case; voxels/slices are not independent specimens
evaluation.selection: none: save final output then open truth/withheld evaluation
evaluation.plots: fixed central orthogonal planes, common method scales, signed/absolute errors, FFT slice, sinograms, learning curves
evaluation.rotational_assumption: measure axis gradient-energy ratios on known volumes and acquired-only FBP; diagnostic, not invariance proof
evaluation.fourier_model: ideal continuous wedge differs from sampled CT+FBP and noncommuting cropping; quantify on known smooth/mixed phantoms
evaluation.claim: deterministic restoration; no calibration, physical worm density or independent-organism claim

resource_snapshot.json.note: Spot measurement; GPU utilization is not an integrated utilization trace. No other compute job at initial preflight. Tool sandbox hides GPU; actual checks run outside it.
